# US Census Demographics — Cloud-Native Mirror

> Nationwide U.S. Census Bureau statistics as GeoParquet + PMTiles with STAC
> metadata: ACS 2020–2024 5-year indicators at block group (~242k), tract
> (~85k), county (3,235) and state level, plus 2020 Decennial Census counts
> for all 8,174,955 census blocks. Every ACS estimate carries its margin of
> error (`*_moe`, 90% confidence); headline statistics carry a reliability
> coefficient of variation (`*_cv`). CC0-1.0; data.census.gov is the
> authoritative source.

Base URL: https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/us-census-catalog/

Read [AGENTS.md](https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/us-census-catalog/AGENTS.md)
first: join keys (GEOIDs nest by prefix: state 2 / county 5 / tract 11 /
block group 12 / block 15 chars), MOE math, and the quirks that produce
silently wrong answers. Each collection has its own AGENTS.md with tested
queries and a README.md documenting every column.

## Collections (collection.json beside each; data asset named)

- Block groups (finest geography with income), themed chunks:
  - block-groups/bg-income/bg-income.parquet — median household & per-capita income, poverty, SNAP, unemployment
  - block-groups/bg-people/bg-people.parquet — age, race/ethnicity, education, density
  - block-groups/bg-housing/bg-housing.parquet — tenure, rent, home value, rent burden, vacancy, stock age
  - block-groups/bg-connectivity/bg-connectivity.parquet — vehicles, commute, internet, computer
- Tracts, same four chunks plus:
  - tracts/tract-wellbeing/tract-wellbeing.parquet — health insurance, disability, foreign-born, income & poverty by race
- counties/counties.parquet and states/states.parquet — all ~35 indicators in one wide table
- blocks/state_fips=*/<fips>.parquet — 2020 P.L. 94-171 block counts, hive-partitioned by state FIPS

## Query patterns (DuckDB)

INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
-- national, no download:
SELECT state, median(median_hh_income) FROM
'https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/us-census-catalog/block-groups/bg-income/bg-income.parquet'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
-- one state's blocks via hive partition (name columns; SELECT * returns raw WKB):
SELECT geoid, pop_total, housing_units FROM
'https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/us-census-catalog/blocks/state_fips=29/29.parquet' LIMIT 5;
-- join chunks 1:1 on geoid; roll blocks up to block groups with substr(geoid,1,12).
-- all 52 block partitions as one table needs object listing, so use the S3 endpoint
-- (anonymous) — a state_fips=*/*.parquet glob over https://data.source.coop/ returns 404:
SET s3_region='us-west-2';
SELECT count(*) FROM read_parquet(
's3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/us-census-catalog/blocks/state_fips=*/*.parquet',
hive_partitioning=true);
-- filter cheaply with the bbox covering struct (it has row-group stats; string columns do not):
-- WHERE bbox.xmin < east AND bbox.xmax > west AND bbox.ymin < north AND bbox.ymax > south

Treat `*_cv` > 0.40 as unreliable; never sum medians across geographies; MOEs
add in quadrature. PMTiles coarse zooms are a coarser census geography, not
the collection's own — counties at z0–z5, tracts in the middle, carrying the
Census Bureau's own estimates for those geographies — so use the GeoParquet
for statistics and check the zoom before reading a tiled feature as a block
group, tract, ZCTA or place.

Source repository: https://github.com/portolan-mirrors/us-census-catalog
